It parses tokens, applying operator precedence rules (+, - at level 1, *, / at level 2) and parenthesis barriers to combine subtrees into Node objects. The solution runs in O(n) time and O(n) space; no candidate is required.
Shunting-yard precedence evaluation with left-associative combination correctly builds binary expression subtrees respecting operator hierarchy and parentheses.
